name: Consultar documentos compartidos y confirmar sus revisiones
description: From the proposal and document manager, the administrator consults the same document identity, current package and history. A new reviewed package preserves its prior versions and linked client/project: with split contracts, service approval off confirms the product contract plus explicitly selected annexes; on confirms product and service contracts plus that selection. The approval preview and custom-document requirements expose only the required contract types. Editing structured sources or replacing enabled draft attachments remains possible. After a stale-source conflict, reviewing the current source updates its metadata without discarding the selected attachment; an explicit retry sends the same file with the reviewed hash. A failed source review retains the attachment and prior hash. A failed confirmation preserves the selected switch, draft and approved package.
